create.title: Built to integrate.
create.sub: The three tools your engineers will use.
items: API
Authenticate with your key and secret, pull offers and conversions, and generate tracking links programmatically, with no manual dashboard work.
Postback
Get conversions pushed to your server in real time (server-to-server), so you never have to log in and check reports. You handle the data on your own system.
Datafeed Manager
Pull live product data like prices, offers, and stock to surface catalogues inside your product.

faq: Generate deeplinks, pull offers and product data, and track sales at item level. Deeplink generation is capped at 1,000 per rolling 30 days.
When a conversion is created or updated, we send the data to a URL you configure, so your system is notified in real time. You handle the received data on your own server.
Can I pull a product datafeed?
Yes. Pull live product data per advertiser to surface in your product. Feeds vary by advertiser.
You'll need a developer to set up the API and postback, but the docs are clear and the endpoints are simple.
